messages:
kai: CI red on PR #4824 — container-build step failed pulling the base image (timeout). Can someone nudge a rerun for just the container-build step and try to preserve docker layer cache? Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/823456789

sophie: pinging infra. do you have the builder job id or link?

kai: job id is 823456789 (builders/cont-build). here: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/823456789 :thumbsup:

ashwin: ah, for that one use the infra rerun tool. command: `ci rerun --job 823456789 --preserve-volumes docker-cache` — that will retry only that job and mount the named volume so docker layers survive. note: if this is a GH Actions run, `gh run rerun 823456789` is the fallback but it won't preserve our cluster volumes.

ryan: also consider adding a small backoff for flaky registry pulls: `ci rerun --job 823456789 --preserve-volumes docker-cache --backoff 30s`. if the base image is corrupted, you'll need a full rebuild: `ci rerun --job 823456789 --force-rebuild`.

kai: running `ci rerun --job 823456789 --preserve-volumes docker-cache` now...

ci-bot: Started rerun for job 823456789 (attempt 2) by kai — https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/823456789/attempt/2 :rocket:

ashwin: i'll tail the logs; if the pull keeps failing i'll spin up a temporary registry mirror and requeue.

kai: thanks — i'll report back. :pray:
